tools.name: rulings_search

Query by HS code (2-10 digits) or keywords; returns rulings with their classified codes, dates, precedent links (what each ruling modifies or revokes)

tools.name: query_series
tools.description: Fetch the data of a series — monthly US port trade by country and commodity, tariff rates, collected duty — as periods and values. Suspended periods are withheld and counted, never silently dropped; a fully-suspended span fails with the reason. Free, CC BY 4.0. No API key required.
